description: Retry permission for agent actions after a failure, a timeout or a lost acknowledgement. An action may be retried automatically only while it is proven idempotent (repeating it cannot create a second business operation) and under the retry ceiling of 3 attempts. A repeat of an action that is not proven idempotent is denied — an ambiguous external outcome must be reconciled against evidence first, never blindly replayed. A repeat of a sensitive action always needs fresh human approval: the approval given for the first attempt does not carry over to a retry.
fallback_reason: No rule matched (for example, the attempt number or idempotency status was not stated); the policy denies by default.

rules.reason: Retry ceiling reached: more than 3 attempts at the same business operation. Stop retrying and escalate instead of attempting again.
This is a repeat of an action that is not proven idempotent. Repeating it could create a second business operation; reconcile the original outcome from evidence first — never auto-replay.
A repeat of a sensitive action needs fresh human approval; the approval for the first attempt does not carry over to retries.
The action is proven idempotent and the attempt is at or under the retry ceiling of 3, so (re)trying cannot create a second business operation.

title: Retry and repeat actions — idempotency first, fresh approval for sensitive repeats
